summary: Emberlane is a mid-market SaaS vendor building product analytics and in-app assistants. Started on Redwood hosted API to validate model quality and latency. POC succeeded on hosted; now evaluating Dedicated for predictable latency and VPC isolation. Key drivers: consistent p95 latency <200-300ms at 60-120 QPS, lower per-token cost vs hosted, and strict compliance (SOC2, KMS). Finance prefers a committed 12mo plan. Expect decision contingent on MSA/DPA redlines, SLA language, and a firm dedicated capacity price.
poc_plan: Phase 1 (hosted): baseline metrics, evaluate model variants, ingest 150k docs, run paraphrase/summarize prompts. Phase 2 (POC Dedicated): 2-week Dedicated trial on 3-node config with VPC peering; run synthetic load to validate autoscaling and slot limits; verify prefix/KV caching behavior. SE to run throughput profiling and provide kernel/quantization recommendations.
legal_status: MSA and DPA currently in review. Main redlines from Emberlane legal: data residency clause (EU customer data must remain in EU), indemnity cap tied to fees, audit rights, and clearer breach notification SLAs. Redwood counter proposed standard indemnity cap and carve-outs for open-source model issues. Emberlane requested explicit SLA p95 latency and credits formula for missed SLOs; legal flagged liability exposure for hallucinations — asking for language limiting model output liability.
technical_requirements: Targets: sustained 100 QPS read-heavy inference, p95 latency target 150-250ms for chat/generate use; cold-start <50ms for KV cache hits; integration: SSO/SAML, KMS key-wrap for embeddings storage, VPC peering with static egress IPs, logging to customer SIEM via syslog/HTTPS.
commercial_notes: Initial ask: 3-node Dedicated pool, 12mo commitment. Emberlane asked for blended per-token + flat node fee model and usage-based autoscale credits. Pricing sensitivity: moderate — will accept higher committed fee if unit cost drops >=25% vs hosted. Finance needs a one-page SOW with billing cadence to approve via procurement.
onboarding_checklist: SE to provide Dedicated runbook, network port list, onboarding timeline (2 weeks), SOC2/attestation docs, KMS integration guide, and sample SLA/credit calculation. CSM to schedule quarterly review cadence post-go-live.
